::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 8th 1883  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Dear Madam

I am sorry to say your story did not come till the number had been chosen and sent to the printer. It is very pretty, but here and there a little long.[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Perhaps the Christmas Number of [*MP*](organizations/other_52.qmd), for which the deadline was July.
